summary: Frontend-only verification of the 'Failover Insights' enhancement on /dashboard/payments. Created a fresh tenant (slug fov-1788275864) via API, added mock (priority 10) and examplepsp (priority 20) sandbox provider accounts, then created two payments: FOV-1788275881 (provider_key=auto, amount_minor=7013 -> failed over mock->examplepsp) and DIR-1788275864 (provider_key=mock, direct route). In the UI (public preview URL) logged in as admin@cloudpay.io, switched the topbar tenant selector to the fresh tenant, and validated: (1) each payment row exposes data-testid='details-button-<reference>' opening the payment-detail-dialog; (2) FOV dialog shows detail-environment=SANDBOX, detail-provider=examplepsp, routing-trace visible with two attempts — routing-attempt-0 = '#1 mock failed (card_declined)' with red XCircle, routing-attempt-1 = '#2 examplepsp succeeded' with green CheckCircle2; (3) DIR dialog shows detail-provider=mock, routing-trace hidden and routing-trace-empty visible with text 'Routed directly to mock — no failover recorded.'; (4) Payments provider dropdown still exposes payment-provider-option-auto ('Auto — priority routing & failover') alongside payment-provider-option-examplepsp and payment-provider-option-mock. All acceptance criteria in the review request pass.

issues: Tenant list continues to accumulate ephemeral test tenants (fov-*, TEST_*, route-*, etc.) from prior iterations — cosmetic noise only.

critical_code_review_comments: Payments.jsx (285 lines) still comfortably below the 700-line threshold; detailFor state + payment-detail-dialog nicely reuses the fetched payment row so no extra network call is needed.

routing-trace renders a.error inline in destructive color only when present — good for the DIR case where each attempt would have error=null. The empty-state fallback correctly keys off metadata?.routing_attempts?.length === 0, so a payment with an empty [] list also hits routing-trace-empty (matches backend behaviour where direct routes skip persisting routing_attempts).
The Details button is unconditionally rendered on every row (unlike Refund which is gated on status) — correct, since routing insight is useful for failed/pending payments too.
